title: Keychron Q1 Pro: The Best Wireless Mechanical Keyboard for Typists
summary: Full CNC machined aluminum body, double-gasket acoustic mounting, hot-swappable switches, and seamless Mac/Windows switching.
pros: Exceptional typing feel and deep sound signature
cons: Heavy metal chassis best suited for stationary desk
Battery life reduced with RGB lighting at max
body: The Keychron Q1 Pro is a premium custom mechanical keyboard built for heavy typing and creator desk setups.
